# native/hmi-ui -- the Qt-free panel GUI runtime (C11, LVGL 9).
#
# Phase 3 of the native port: loads a bundle's project.edsui directly, draws
# it with LVGL straight to DRM/KMS (no Qt, no compositor) and speaks the
# CONTRACT section 2 wire protocol to hmi-hwd. lv_conf.h configures LVGL;
# lvgl/ is the pinned upstream submodule (release/v9.3); third_party/cjson
# is the JSON parser (MIT). src/gen/ is generated by schema/gen_schema.py
# from the Designer's registry and Theme.qml -- never edited by hand.
#
# Build (WSL, x86 headless):      native/hmi-ui/build.sh [--test]
# Build for the panel (aarch64):  native/hmi-ui/arm64/build.sh  (bookworm chroot)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(hmi-ui VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# FROZEN CONTRACT (native previews swarm, 2026-09-22; owner W1).
# HMI_UI_WITH_DRM=OFF builds the headless-only runtime (PNG rendering,
# --render-widget/--headless) with no libdrm and no evdev: what the Studio
# ships on Windows/macOS to preview designs with the panel's own renderer.
# The default stays ON on Linux (the panel). lv_conf.h reads the matching
# HMI_UI_WITH_DRM compile definition to switch LV_USE_LINUX_DRM/LV_USE_EVDEV.
option(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM "Build the DRM/KMS display and evdev input (Linux panel)" ON)
if(WIN32 OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows")
    set(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()

if(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM)
    find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
    pkg_check_modules(DRM REQUIRED libdrm)
endif()
add_compile_definitions(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM=$<BOOL:${HMI_UI_WITH_DRM}>)

set(LV_BUILD_CONF_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lv_conf.h" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_USE_THORVG_INTERNAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(lvgl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
# The DRM driver (src/drivers/display/drm) includes <xf86drm.h>; LVGL's own
# CMake does not add libdrm, so do it here.
if(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM)
    target_include_directories(lvgl PUBLIC ${DRM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
    target_link_libraries(lvgl PUBLIC ${DRM_LIBRARIES})
endif()
target_link_libraries(lvgl PUBLIC m)

add_library(cjson STATIC third_party/cjson/cJSON.c)
target_include_directories(cjson PUBLIC third_party/cjson)

file(GLOB KIT_WIDGETS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/widgets/w_*.c)
add_library(hmi-ui-core STATIC
    src/compat.c
    src/value.c
    src/model.c
    src/log.c
    src/theme.c
    src/registry.c
    src/runtime.c
    src/display.c
    src/icons.c
    src/alarms.c
    src/tags.c
    src/bind.c
    src/gen/kit_schema.c
    src/widgets/kit.c
    src/widgets/probe.c
    ${KIT_WIDGETS}
)
target_include_directories(hmi-ui-core PUBLIC src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hmi-ui-core PUBLIC lvgl cjson m)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(hmi-ui-core PUBLIC ws2_32)
endif()
target_compile_options(hmi-ui-core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
target_compile_definitions(hmi-ui-core PUBLIC HMI_UI_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")

add_executable(hmi-ui src/main.c)
target_link_libraries(hmi-ui PRIVATE hmi-ui-core)
target_compile_options(hmi-ui PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

# The feasibility spike drives DRM directly; it has no place in the headless build.
if(HMI_UI_WITH_DRM)
    add_executable(hmi-ui-spike spike/main.c)
    target_link_libraries(hmi-ui-spike PRIVATE lvgl m)
endif()

install(TARGETS hmi-ui DESTINATION lib/hmi/ui)

enable_testing()
add_subdirectory(tests)
